title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://dpaste.org/BXu7Y/raw (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A URL associated with attacker activity linked to CVE-2021-42013 was observed multiple times in the wild on 2026-10-31. This URL was used in attacker payloads involving tool downloads or callbacks, indicating its role in ingress tool transfer (technique T1105). The attacker infrastructure was identified in India. Security teams are advised to block and monitor this URL and review proxy, web, and WAF logs for any access attempts.
